key_patterns: Reference patterns to MIRROR (not edit): (1) MediaSessionProbe.java — MediaSessionManager.getActiveSessions(ComponentName) requires an enabled NotificationListenerService; NotificationAccess.isGranted reads Settings.Secure 'enabled_notification_listeners'. The experimental module needs its OWN NotificationListenerService + its OWN NotificationAccess-equivalent pointing at its OWN ComponentName. (2) SceneRenderer.java — TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY via WindowManager.LayoutParams, Settings.canDrawOverlays gate, removeViewImmediate cleanup. The interlude overlay here is INTERACTIVE video so it should NOT use FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE the way SceneRenderer does; it is a fullscreen MATCH_PARENT TextureView/VideoView. (3) OverlayService.java — foreground service lifecycle: createNotificationChannel + startForeground in onCreate, START_STICKY, stopSelf on permission loss. The experimental service MUST declare foregroundServiceType="mediaPlayback" and request FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK (NOT specialUse). (4) MainActivity.java — TV D-pad UI built programmatically with LinearLayout/Button/ScrollView, LEANBACK_LAUNCHER, Theme.Material.NoActionBar, uses-feature leanback required=true. Deterministic-test seam style: constructor injection of an interface (e.g. MediaSessionProbe(Context, Listener)); do the same so the POC state machine + safe-resume guard are Android-free and JUnit-testable with returnDefaultValues stubs.
